notes: New: ElvUI & Tukui tab (from tukui.org). Installed ones are kept up to date like your other addons — Check for updates, Update all and the background check all include them. Tukui itself has no WoW Forever version yet, so it's refused with a clear message instead of installing something that won't load. Changed: the "N addons updated" summary no longer pops up by itself — click the "✓ N updated" button next to Update all to see it (and Undo). Background updates no longer show a Windows notification either, unless something needs you.
